The mainnet tx formerly excluded as eip155:1:0xfab5912f (MainnetSettler, no-defect, on a mistaken truncation-artifact reading; exclusion removed) is a real drain of 308,453,642 HOLD from 0xa31d98b1 through Settler 0x70bf6634 (the attacker 0x3a388773 realised 17.64 ETH) and belongs to this campaign. eip155:1:0xc18ec2eb7d41638d9982281e76694.name: Xave Finance SafeSnap DaoModule executes unchallenged proposals after a 1-second timeout
eip155:1:0xc18ec2eb7d41638d9982281e76694.note: Cohort: in, as a configuration vulnerability (rule 1, privileged state exploited later), not governance as designed. DaoModule 0x8f9036732b9aa9b82d8f35e54b71faeb2f573e2f (verified Gnosis SafeSnap DaoModule, created 0x07f2739404c6d287dba5d0a12da82df54b02fe582d868df3b895184d65e27d8e at block 12698489 by 0x30ca8f1e) is a module of Safe 0x7eae370e6a76407c3955a2f0bbca853c38e6454e and reads, at block 15704736, questionTimeout 1 s, questionCooldown 0, minimumBond 0, arbitrator = the Safe, answerExpiration 7 days.
